scope.dataset: Official COCO POPE fixed question files

evaluation.parser: Exact official POPE rule as retained in pinned scripts/run_pope.py; no new judge.
evaluation.primary: Unweighted mean of F1 across the three groups, with each group always reported separately.

execution_policy.future_B0: Fresh inference if raw-record compatibility cannot be verified; use one uniform 1024-token cap and separate run ID. No automatic historical migration.
execution_policy.historical_answer_reuse: Only after image/question hashes, model, template, inference settings, EOS and provenance are verified; timing requires separate measurement.
execution_policy.hardware_fit: NOT_VERIFIED; reference settings do not assert fit on current target machine.

change_budget.control_rule: A necessary control must not be dropped to meet the cap. If the claim needs more conditions, narrow the claim or revise the scope.
change_budget.candidate_method: NOT_SELECTED; only a fixed one-step change may enter the initial feasibility check.
change_budget.scope_expansion: No automatic expansion to new datasets, models, training, multi-round agents or custom annotation.

development_boundary.policy: Before new method tuning, group questions by image and record a deterministic development/evaluation split. Historical full-set exposure must be disclosed.
development_boundary.assignment: Sort official image filenames and split with fixed seed 0; generate and retain manifest before method tuning.
development_boundary.reporting: Recompute B0 per subset; historical full-500 H0 metrics cannot be used as the 450-image comparator.
development_boundary.independence_caveat: A prospective split of previously inspected benchmark data is not a never-seen external test.

stopping.engineering: After two documented pilot versions or at the feasibility checkpoint, stop adding modules if the baseline or candidate is unstable.
stopping.scientific: Freeze choices before evaluation; keep null and negative outcomes. Do not repeatedly tune against final evaluation results.
stopping.resource: No GPU run or paid resource authorized by this planning artifact.
